resources.string: Reads only supported TV launcher cards and detail pages so the selected title can be opened in an app you choose.
Open launcher recommendations in your preferred media app. Free, open source, and account-free.
The accessibility service is restricted to supported TV launchers. Selected titles are sent to Cinemeta for identification; no account or device identifier is collected.
Fall back to the next installed app if the first choice is missing
Prefer whichever installed app can open the exact title
Redirect recognised YouTube cards to SmartTube
Test selected app with Iron Man
SmartTube stable or beta is not installed.
The test resolves “Iron Man (2008)” without opening another app.
Lookup failed. Check the network and try again.
Could not open accessibility settings on this device.

Launcher layouts are controlled by the TV vendor and change without notice. This list shows what OpenTVBridge saw and did, so a failure can be reported precisely. It is held in memory only and is cleared when the app stops.
Nothing recorded yet. Select a film or series on the home screen, then come back.
There is nothing to copy yet.

These are all optional and all belong to you. OpenTVBridge ships no API key of its own; without anything here it uses the keyless Cinemeta lookup and opens searches rather than exact items. Values are stored only on this device and are excluded from backups.
Improves matching for titles Cinemeta does not index, and supplies the id Fladder\'s request route needs.
With your own token, Plex opens the item page instead of a search.
With a server and key, Jellyfin and Fladder open the exact item in your library instead of a search.
Emby publishes no intent contract, so this is best-effort: with a server it tries the item, otherwise it just opens the app.
Needs “Allow remote control via HTTP” in Kodi. OpenTVBridge finds the title in your library and plays it; if Kodi does not have it, the next destination is used instead.
Trakt has no TV app to open, so this is not a destination: when enabled, an opened title is added to your watchlist.
Add opened titles to my Trakt watchlist
